post.ref: Baba Sheikh Farid Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1379
post.meaning: They speak of longing as pain, but longing is a king. A body that has never ached for the Beloved is a burning-ground.
post.caption:
इश्क़ और सब्र की एक पंक्ति, सूफ़ी रंग में 🕊️

📖 Baba Sheikh Farid, Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1379

अगर यह बात सच लगी, तो अपनों के साथ Share करें। 🙏

#sufi #sufism #sufiquotes #sufipoetry #spirituality

reel.meaning: Work as hard as those who work for gain, but do it without clinging, for the welfare of all.
reel.caption:
कृष्ण की यह बात आज के दिन के लिए है 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 3.25

Save कर लें, मुश्किल दिन में काम आएगा। 🔖

#krishna #bhagavadgita #radhekrishna #gita #sanatandharma
